reason: Both plans satisfy the hard requirements, but Response A's phasing is more risk-aware, isolating enterprise/edge-case accounts into a dedicated final phase before any decommission discussion, whereas Response B lumps enterprise accounts into the same 73% general-availability batch as everyone else and gives its final phase a 0% migration figure, which is a weaker treatment of the phased-percentage requirement. Response A also stays a clean, professional document, while Response B ends with an out-of-place, unprofessional 'May the Force be with you' line that has no place in a formal rollout plan.
